dropdown: list that opens when you tap
tab: label you can click at the top
SSID: the name of a wireless internet network
two-factor authentication: a second step to prove it is you
2FA: a second step to prove it is you
drag and drop: press and hold, then move and let go
right-click: press the right side of the mouse button
double-click: press the mouse button twice quickly
long press: press and hold for a moment
address bar: box at the top where you type a web address
hyperlink: clickable text that takes you somewhere
search engine: a website that helps you find things
CC: copy — other people who get a copy of your email
BCC: hidden copy — they get it but nobody sees their name
reply all: send your reply to everyone in the conversation
forward: send someone else's email to a new person
draft: an email you started but haven't sent yet
bandwidth throttling: slowing down your internet on purpose
driver: software that helps your computer talk to a device
HDMI: the cable that carries picture and sound to your TV
operating system: the main software that runs your computer
pixel: a tiny dot on your screen
reboot: turn off and turn on again
USB: the rectangular plug on a cable
widget: a small tool on your screen
zip file: a folder that has been squeezed smaller
